title: Attainable dual-index permutations in four vectorial dual-bent constructions
summary: Classify every equation-(2) permutation realizable by the source's four construction principles for vectorial dual-bent functions.

formal_statement.body: Fix the output basis and the choice of vectorial dual. For a vectorial dual-bent function $F:V_n^{(p)}\to V_m^{(p)}$ produced by a construction in Sections III-VI, equation (2) defines a permutation $\sigma$ of $V_m^{(p)}$ with $\sigma(0)=0$ through $(F_a)^*=(F^*)_{\sigma(a)}$. Determine exactly which permutations $\sigma$ are realizable across all four construction principles, giving constructions for attainable maps and impossibility proofs for unattainable maps under the fixed convention.

scope.domain: Dual-index permutations of source-constructed vectorial dual-bent functions
assumptions: F is produced by one of the source's Sections III-VI construction principles
Vectorial dual-bent functions and equation (2) use the source definitions
The output basis and vectorial-dual choice are fixed so that sigma is represented unambiguously
parameters: n and m: input and output dimensions
sigma: permutation of the output space fixing zero
scope.unresolved_remainder: A 2026 result realizes inverse-power maps in a Section IV-type construction and proves that the Section V-type equation-(22) construction cannot have nonlinear sigma. Still unknown are the attainable maps for Sections III and VI, whether Section IV admits maps beyond the proved inverse-power family, the exact attainable linear maps for Section V under the fixed convention, and possible non-power permutations in the remaining families.

progress.summary: The source asks which equation-(2) permutations can be achieved by its vectorial dual-bent construction principles.

Theorem 5 realizes inverse-power permutations in a generalized-Maiorana--McFarland variant, while Corollary 20 forces sigma to be linear for the equation-(22) construction; neither result classifies all four source families.
